questions: Is the primary reason for your visit today a new or worsening symptom, rather than a routine check-up or follow-up of a known condition?
Do you have chest pain or discomfort?
Do you have shortness of breath?
Have you experienced any sudden weakness or numbness, especially on one side of your body?
Do you have a severe headache or the worst headache of your life?
Have you unintentionally lost weight in the past 6 months?
Do you have a fever or feel feverish?
Do you have fatigue or low energy?
Do you have any chronic medical conditions such as diabetes, hypertension, asthma, or heart disease?
Are you currently taking any prescription medications?
Do you have any medication allergies?
Do you currently smoke or have you ever smoked regularly?

- Somatic symptom disorder / health anxiety (if unvoiced symptoms exist)
